verdict.rationale: kitty keeps its configuration in a documented plain-text kitty.conf file, and startup sessions specify working environments. A hands-on probe confirmed that `kitten @ ls` dumps the full window, tab and layout state as JSON and `kitten @ get-text` reads window contents back out. Together these give you your settings and session state in open formats you can take elsewhere. But nothing in the evidence describes an explicit export or migration path. Missing for 10: documented data-export or migration feature, explicit statement that all user data is in open formats, any independent evidence of users migrating their data out.
